key_rationale: With headline CPI at 4.85% and core inflation significantly lower at 3.25%, the real policy rate is now sufficiently restrictive to anchor expectations without stifling the 6.30% GVA growth. Maintaining the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance is no longer appropriate given that the policy repo rate of 6.50% has successfully transitioned the economy toward a neutral setting, and further tightening risks an unnecessary sacrifice of growth momentum.
